blogs.title: Dyskeratosis Congenita Without the Triad: Recognizing Atypical Telomere Biology Disorders
blogs.description: Explores how Telomere Biology Disorders (TBDs) can present in adulthood without the classic mucocutaneous triad (nail dystrophy, leukoplakia, pigmentation). Discusses the importance of maintaining a high index of suspicion for TBDs in young adults with multisystem failure, even when dermatological signs are absent.

blogs.title: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis in a 20-Year-Old: When 'Idiopathic' Means Genetic
blogs.description: Analyzes the red flags for genetic pulmonary fibrosis in young patients. Highlights the case of a woman in her late 20s with IPF and hepatic fibrosis, emphasizing that 'idiopathic' labels in young adults should trigger a workup for telomere biology disorders and other genetic etiologies.

blogs.title: The B12 Red Herring: Distinguishing Nutritional Marrow Failure from Telomere Disease
blogs.description: Discusses the diagnostic tension between severe nutritional deficiencies (like B12) and underlying genetic marrow failure. Examines how correcting deficiencies may not resolve the underlying phenotype and how telomere shortening can predispose marrow to stress-induced failure.

blogs.title: Decoding the VUS: Clinical Correlation in Genetic Testing for Rare Syndromes
blogs.description: Focuses on the management of Variants of Uncertain Significance (VUS) in clinical practice. Uses the patient's monoallelic PARN variant to illustrate how clinical phenotype can support a diagnosis of TBD even when genetic classification remains uncertain.

blogs.title: Therapeutic Pitfalls in Telomere Biology Disorders: HSCT, Androgens, and Avoiding Toxins
blogs.description: Outlines critical management considerations for TBD patients, including the potential curative role of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, the use of androgens, and the importance of avoiding cytotoxic therapies that could accelerate marrow failure.

blogs.title: The Diagnostic Algorithm for Undifferentiated Pancytopenia and Organ Fibrosis
blogs.description: Proposes a practical clinical workflow for evaluating young adults with pancytopenia and unexplained fibrosis. Discusses when to order telomere length testing versus whole-exome sequencing and how to prioritize genetic testing in undifferentiated multisystem disease.
